root_cause: The multiplication `(p->y - min_y) * target_height` was written with a comment claiming the operands are always small enough to avoid overflow, without any actual bounds validation. This assumption does not hold for arbitrary/fuzzed font glyph coordinates, allowing the signed multiplication to overflow FT_Pos (a signed long), which is undefined behavior in C and can yield incorrect or attacker-influenced results.
